ne24:1.1: And what is the conveying of characteristics?
ne24:2.1: “Therefore, of the one whose mind is guarded, right thought is his range”. This is the verse.
ne24:2.2: “Therefore, of the one whose mind is guarded, right thought is his range”. This is the six faculties: when the six faculties are taken up, the five faculties are taken up.
ne24:2.3: “Right effort is devoted to right concentration”. With right concentration taken up, the noble eightfold path is taken up.
ne24:2.4: What is the reason for that?
ne24:2.5: For right concentration gives rise to right thought; that gives rise to right speech; that gives rise to right action; that gives rise to right livelihood; that gives rise to right effort; that gives rise to right mindfulness; that gives rise to right concentration; that gives rise to right release; that gives rise to the knowledge and vision of release.
ne24:2.6: The conveying of characteristics has been applied.
